glosses: knight (a medieval Western European nobleman serving as an armored and mounted warrior; a person on whom knighthood has been conferred)
knight, cavalier, gallant (a brave and chivalrous man)

examples.text: Рыцарь без дамы - как дерево без листьев.
examples.en: A knight without a lady was like a tree without leaves.
The knights attacked the castle at dawn.
The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

examples.text: Том пришёл мне на помощь, словно рыцарь в сияющих доспехах.
examples.en: Tom came to my rescue, like a knight in shining armor.
